definitions.contact: First opposite-fighter native manifold observation versus positive raw normal impulse are separate. Native impulses remain uncalibrated.
definitions.woundTime: Callback timestamp is recorded before G.t increments; post-Combat frame reflects that solver step and is DT later. First unhealthy is broader than first wound.
definitions.motor: Final jointConfigureMotor target velocity request (arguments[3]), not measured body angular velocity, motor impulse or work. Manual shoulder and wrist explicit torques are distinct.
definitions.withdrawal: Recorded extra goal before/after command, injury or special states; post-Combat injury may follow the controller call in that same step. Nonzero requested field is observational if extra is gated to zero.
definitions.causality: Identical supplied scripted player inputs with original reactive opponent; native/AI divergence does not establish victory, injury prevention, finish/recovery or human-motion acceptance.
